Bundled font notices
====================

The following notices apply to font files under `src/lib/fonts/`. The common
SIL Open Font License 1.1 text is in `OFL-1.1.txt`.

Geist
-----

Files: `Geist-Variable.woff2`
Source: https://github.com/vercel/geist-font

Copyright 2024 The Geist Project Authors
(https://github.com/vercel/geist-font)

License: SIL Open Font License 1.1. A source-specific copy is also retained as
`src/lib/fonts/Geist-OFL.txt`.

Cascadia Code
-------------

Files: `CascadiaCode-Regular.woff2`, `CascadiaCode-Bold.woff2`
Source: https://github.com/microsoft/cascadia-code

Copyright (c) 2019 - Present, Microsoft Corporation,
with Reserved Font Name Cascadia Code.

The embedded name table in the bundled files also states:

© 2020 Microsoft Corporation. All Rights Reserved.

Cascadia Code is a trademark of the Microsoft group of companies.

License: SIL Open Font License 1.1.
